title: After Historic Intervention, 155 Emerges as Yen’s Next Big Test

summary:
Japan’s historic joint intervention with the US is shifting market focus to whether the yen can strengthen beyond 155 per dollar, a threshold strategists view as a key test for the rally’s staying power.
The level carries significance far beyond standard technicals. Japan’s April and May interventions briefly dragged dollar-yen toward 155 before it resumed climbing, reinforcing views that official action merely buys time.
Now, investors are weighing whether a clean break below it signals a structural shift.
Steve Englander, Global Head: G10 FX Research at Standard Chartered, discusses the move to intervene and what it means for global currencies. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: The prime minister’s biggest risk right now is from some of his own supporters.

title: Five Die in Ukraine Drone Strike in Moscow Region, Governor Says
title_cn: 州长称乌克兰莫斯科地区无人机袭击造成五人死亡
summary: At least five people were killed and 10 injured at an industrial zone south of Moscow during a Ukrainian drone strike, according to the regional governor.
